verses.text: But there will be no more gloom for the land that was in trouble. In the past, God humbled the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali. But in the future he will make it glorious, the road by the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light. A light has shined on those who lived in the land of the shadow of death.

You have made the nation grow larger. You have increased their joy. They are happy in your presence, like people are happy at harvest time, like soldiers are glad when they divide the treasure they captured.
For you have broken the heavy yoke on their shoulders, the rod used to beat them, and the stick of the one who treated them cruelly, just as you did on the day you defeated Midian.
Every warrior's boot used in the noisy battle, and every piece of clothing rolled in blood, will be burned. They will be fuel for the fire.

For a child has been born to us. A son has been given to us. He will carry the responsibility of ruling on his shoulders. He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

His rule and his peace will keep growing, and there will be no end to them. He will rule on the throne of David and over his kingdom. He will set it up firmly and keep it strong with justice and righteousness from that time on and forever. The burning love of the LORD of Armies will make this happen.
The Lord has sent a message against the people of Jacob, and it has fallen on Israel.
All the people will know it, Ephraim and the people living in Samaria, who say with pride and arrogant hearts,
"The bricks have fallen down, but we will rebuild with cut stone. The fig trees have been cut down, but we will plant cedars in their place."
So the LORD has made the enemies of Rezin strong against them, and he has stirred up their enemies.
The Syrians from the east and the Philistines from the west have swallowed up Israel with open mouths. Even after all this, his anger has not turned away. His hand is still raised to strike.
But the people have not turned back to the one who struck them. They have not looked for the LORD of Armies.
So the LORD will cut off from Israel both head and tail, both palm branch and reed, in a single day.
The elders and important people are the head, and the prophets who teach lies are the tail.
Those who lead these people mislead them, and those who are led are swallowed up.

So the Lord will not be pleased with their young men, and he will not show pity to their orphans and widows. For everyone is godless and evil, and every mouth speaks foolishness. Even after all this, his anger has not turned away. His hand is still raised to strike.
Wickedness burns like a fire. It eats up the briers and thorns. It sets the thick forest on fire, and it rises up in a column of smoke.
Because of the anger of the LORD of Armies, the land is burned up, and the people are like fuel for the fire. No one spares even their own brother.
They grab food on the right, but are still hungry. They eat on the left, but are not satisfied. Each one eats the flesh of their own arm.
Manasseh eats Ephraim, and Ephraim eats Manasseh, and together they turn against Judah. Even after all this, his anger has not turned away. His hand is still raised to strike.
